Game Overview

In Physics Knife, the core idea is straightforward: wield a virtual blade with uncanny realism. Feel the thrill as you deftly throw, spin, and manipulate your knife through intricate challenges. Discover the limitless possibilities of precise physics-based gameplay that keeps you engaged at every twist and turn.
